title: Crystallography
description: A crystal is one pattern of atoms repeated in every direction. X-rays are short enough to be scattered by its planes, and the angles at which they reinforce give the spacing between them. Unlocks the X-ray Diffractometer and the Laue Pattern.

puzzle.goal: Two neighbouring planes of atoms, a distance a apart, scatter X-rays of wavelength λ arriving at a glancing angle θ. The rays reinforce when the extra path between the planes is a whole number n of wavelengths. Write a.
puzzle.name: Bragg reflection condition
puzzle.ask: Find d in ångströms for copper Kα (L = @{L} Å), first order (n = @{n}), reflecting at t = @{t} rad.
puzzle.method: The ray scattered by the deeper plane travels 2d·sin θ further; the waves add up when that is a whole number of wavelengths.
